title: stereo_depth node: SGBM depth from the synced pair on the ToF contract, registered in lint and CI
sizeReason: One new node package (pyproject, lock, six modules, five test files, README) plus the lint/CI registry lines that must land with it (test_ci_workflow fails when a node dir is missing from the matrix); splitting the package leaves half a node with no runnable entry point.
requirement: Tests first (nodes/stereo_depth/tests: test_config.py, test_calibration.py, test_depth.py, test_messages.py, test_node.py with rclpy and message_filters mocked), seen failing. (1) Restore each prior file with `git show 08bc9b8^:nodes/stereo_depth/<path> > nodes/stereo_depth/<path>` (not poetry.lock) and convert to a uv project like nodes/bridges/arducam_tof (ruff, vulture, poe lint/test, ros2-metrics path dep, package = false); declare numpy and opencv-python-headless (numpy guard); commit uv.lock. (2) config.py: frozen pydantic DepthConfig, extra=forbid, from STEREO_DEPTH_CONFIG or /etc/ros2/stereo_depth/config.yaml; keys left_image_topic (/overview_camera/image_raw), right_image_topic (/stereo/right/image_raw), depth_topic (/stereo/depth/image_raw), camera_info_topic (/stereo/camera_info), publish_disparity (false) and disparity_topic (/stereo/disparity), calibration_dir (/var/lib/ros2/camera_calibration), num_disparities (48, multiple of 16), block_size (5, odd), p1, p2, uniqueness_ratio, speckle_window_size, speckle_range, disp12_max_diff, pre_filter_cap, min_depth_m (0.3) < max_depth_m (4.0), sync_slop_s (0.002), max_rate_hz (5.0), matcher_threads, frame_id, metrics_port (19113). (3) calibration.py: load and validate stereo_left.yaml / stereo_right.yaml (ROS camera_info YAML: K, D, R, P, size; right P[3] = -fx*B) and stereo.yaml (R, T, Q, size, rms); write them (contract stereo-calibration-files, used by T4); build initUndistortRectifyMap maps once (CV_16SC2); missing or invalid files return None with the reason. (4) depth.py: restored disparity_to_depth_mm plus StereoSGBM MODE_SGBM_3WAY on grey rectified images, fixed-point disparity / 16; a synthetic rectified pair shifted by a known disparity gives depth within 2% of f*B/d; invalid, unmatched and out-of-range pixels are 0. (5) node.py: message_filters.ApproximateTimeSynchronizer (slop from config) on the two image topics; rate cap at max_rate_hz; publishes 16UC1 mm depth (left stamp, frame_id) and camera_info (rectified left P, same header), optional DisparityImage. Nothing is published without valid calibration, on a size mismatch or a skew above slop; each case logs (throttled) and increments stereo_depth_frames_dropped_total{reason}; also stereo_depth_frames_published_total and histograms for matcher seconds and pair skew seconds. While calibration is missing it re-checks the files periodically. No cv_bridge (numpy reshape of Image.data). (6) README: topics, config keys, metrics, no-placeholder behaviour, CPU estimate, how to run tests. (7) Registered in .github/workflows/ci.yml matrix, root pyproject.toml lint-nodes and scripts/lint-all-nodes.sh. (8) MEMORY.md records the decision: IMX219 stereo replaces the IMX708 and the ToF (fixed lens vs VCM drift, ToF never came up, client CPU).
value: The robot gets real depth from the stereo pair, and never fake depth.
notes: Restore prior code with `git show 08bc9b8^:<path> > <path>` (or > <new path>) and adapt; never retype it. The old node consumed stereo_image_proc DisparityImage; the new one runs SGBM itself (design D1). Match the opencv-python-headless pin used by mcp_server if numpy constraints allow (aarch64 wheels known to deploy). SGBM P1/P2 and WLS are left to the builder: WLS needs opencv-contrib and stays out unless measured at >= 5 fps. Brief settings: P1 8*cn*bs^2-style 200/800, uniquenessRatio 10, speckleWindowSize 100, speckleRange 2, disp12MaxDiff 1, preFilterCap 31. Do not edit tests/README.md (T6 writes the per-node section) or ansible files (T6).
verify: cd nodes/stereo_depth && uv run pytest tests -v && uv run poe lint && cd ../.. && uv run pytest tests/test_ci_workflow.py -v && uv run poe lint-nodes

title: Config-driven stereo calibration and benchmark tools in the stereo_depth package
requirement: Tests first (nodes/stereo_depth/tests/test_calibrate.py, test_bench.py), seen failing. (1) python3 -m stereo_depth.calibrate, config from STEREO_CALIBRATE_CONFIG or config/calibrate.yaml (board type chessboard or ChArUco, squares, square and marker size, dictionary, capture count, image dir, output dir /var/lib/ros2/camera_calibration, RMS limit). Capture mode saves synced pairs from /overview_camera/image_raw and /stereo/right/image_raw; solve mode runs per-camera calibrateCamera, stereoCalibrate (CALIB_FIX_INTRINSIC) and stereoRectify (alpha 0) and writes stereo_left.yaml, stereo_right.yaml and stereo.yaml through stereo_depth.calibration (contract stereo-calibration-files). (2) On a synthetic board pair rendered with known K, D, R and T the recovered baseline is within 1% and RMS under 0.5 px; the written files load in the T3 loader and pass the T2 launch gate rule (12-element P, non-zero focal terms); it refuses to write above the configured RMS limit. (3) python3 -m stereo_depth.bench, config config/bench.yaml (sizes, numDisparities, matcher BM / SGBM 3WAY / SGBM, threads, runs): times each cell on a synthetic textured pair and prints median ms and cores at 5 fps; a test runs a one-cell grid and checks the table shape. (4) nodes/stereo_depth/README.md: calibration procedure (mount, print board, capture, solve, check RMS; the node picks the files up without a redeploy), the bench command, and the new tests in its test list.
value: The user can calibrate the mounted pair and measure the real Pi cost without writing code.
notes: Use cv2.aruco CharucoBoard / CharucoDetector (OpenCV 4.7+ API). Calibrate at the published 480x360. Matcher parameters come from DepthConfig defaults (contract stereo-depth-config). Config file over CLI flags. Brief section 4 has the benchmark method.
verify: cd nodes/stereo_depth && uv run pytest tests -v && uv run poe lint
